reviews.comment: I think he would fare better if he wasn't teaching at 8am. Seems to be waking up during the lectures. Messes up steps a lot, doesn't notice until much later, has to revise examples. lmao. I guess the only good thing is that the quizzes are generally easy.
What the last guy said . Oh and also just breath before it goes in.
bro this guy is fried asl

Go to class/office hours! Answers HW problems in class if you ask at the beginning. Open note/book midterm. HW can be hard but is similar to exam. TA grader was poor and had him regrade my work in office hours, added 10-15 pts each time. Final was take home for a week, but you had to go to class to know that. Really does care about the students.

Great professor. He's super nice and caring, and makes his exam criteria very clear beforehand. He's very sympathetic if you need help.

There were only a few homeworks, and were pretty tough if you weren't there to go over the topics in lecture, but studying them prepares you well for the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All work that Dr Comech assigns (HW and exams) is exactly like what you cover in class. No tricks, very straightforward work. My only complaint is that lecture material is not available online, and the ONLY way to keep up with material is getting it in class. Despite this, I really enjoyed this class and Dr Comech is quite funny. Would recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had four diff eq profs in one semester and my final month or so was with Comech. I got an A because his practice exams are basically his exams, he encourages people to learn the material for the sake of learning and does not try to destroy you with pointlessly hard exams. Very kind and caring to me even though I skipped plenty of lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Caring--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Comech's reviews are way worse than he truly is. In terms of teaching, if you value learning and understanding concepts probably don't take him because he is messy. But if you care about your grade, take him. His test reviews are very similar to the exams. Has a lot of hws but as long as you plan ahead you're good. use the mlc videos!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are always interesting yet they don't help you understand the content. Do not go to lectures expecting to learn the material, but it is easy enough to read the textbook and get a good grade. His practice exams prepare you very well for the actual exams. Very helpful outside of class, and normally does homework problems during lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational--Hilarious--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Comech is overall a pretty good professor. His lectures are a bit messy and are typically harder than anything you will see on exams but I felt he prepared us well for what we would see. His HW was fine and his exams are very similar to the HW. My only gripe would be that he doesn't really use technology at all just gradescope for submitting HW

reviews.comment: Got transferred into his class halfway through the sem. Never attended lectures. If u study the practice exams he gives, the exam/final will be a breeze. It's literally the same, js different numbers. Has a somewhat thick accent. Didn't learn anything in the class, only memorized exams.

I wish people wouldn't associate the difficulty of Diff Eq with Comech. I personally thought that he was a great professor. reviews.comment: Easy A/B if you watch the Math Learning Center videos, otherwise it is a nightmare. I learned nothing from lecture. The HWs are 30+ questions every 1.5 weeks, TAs grade only 2 of the easier questions and answers are in the back of the textbook. PQs are usually simple from previous week's lectures. Exam review is literally the exam. Curves at end!!

reviews.comment: I got all A's through Cal 1-3; I ended up with a D in this class and I have to retake it. Prof Comech isn't terrible but his lectures are messy. reviews.comment: He was okay, but only taught using the whiteboard and doesn't post notes online. A nice prof and easy to get ahold of outside of class. I did poorly on the exams and ended up q dropping the class.

reviews.comment: Generally not a bad math prof, but he ONLY use whiteboard for lecture, his handwriting is readable, no notes can be found after class and DID NOT use Canvas. Make sure to to lectures. He has everything on Gradescope, but it is clear. Reading textbook helps u a lot on hw.

reviews.comment: His lectures aren't great, he starts writing on a whiteboard and you kinda just have to figure stuff out. Not at all impossible to get an A though, but be prepared to learn outside of class. He gave us an extra credit assignment and a curve.

He was a very disorganized professor and never explained what he was doing on the board, just expected us to understand. I learned more from a substitute for 2 weeks than Comech. I thought this class was difficult, but when studying for the final, I realized how easy the concepts were, and how much he did not teach. Do not take him.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Comech was frustrating at times. He edited his grading criteria halfway through the semester. He spent more time on certain topics as opposed to others. The class was very difficult for me but doable. 2 open note tests (which saved my grade) and a closed note final, along with homework. Overall he was okay, probably one of the better choices.

He often went on tangents that led to some material not being delved into enough. It felt like it was disorganized to a awful degree. We only found out how grades were calculated right before the final so it turned out the syllabus was incorrect. The final, unlike the other exams, didn't match the review. I'd take this course with someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Literally the worst professor ever... Do not take this man. He is very disorganized and even left class for three weeks and just popped up again as if nothing happened. reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I dont get why everyone else is griping on here. If you are diligent and organized then Dr. Comech is the best choice by far. No homework grade, open-note quizzes, open-note exams (yes that is right), and he curves slightly. If you have organized notes, follow his problems, actually go to class, and practice a bit of the hw, it's a super easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Grades are determined by tests and quizzes only; no homework is required, but you should do practice problems for the quizzes because they're worth 20%. The first two tests were open note, but the final wasn't so you should study more for the first two tests than you think you really need to. Overall, great professor with helpful lectures.

reviews.comment: He is an amazing professor, I would recommend to others to take him for Math 308. 40% of your grade comes from homeworks/quizzes, a coin is tossed to pick which. reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is just an okay. He is hard to follow during lectures and he talks a lot facing the board. Majority of the grades are from your weekly homework and pop quizzes so as long as you stay on top of the homework, you should be fine. His tests are easy if you understand the sample exams because they are almost exactly the same.

He is a good guy. His lectures are all over the place and hard to follow, hes unavailable outside of class, and 40% of your grade is pop quizzes.
